value:
set -e
# 4 项 sed 优化(prefill 无 batched-tokens)
sed -i 's/--max-num-seqs 1/--max-num-seqs 4/' /start_server.sh
sed -i 's/"kv_buffer_size": 1000000000/"kv_buffer_size": 2000000000/g' /start_server.sh
sed -i 's/--block-size 64/--block-size 64 --kv-cache-dtype fp8/' /start_server.sh
sed -i 's/UCX_MAX_RMA_RAILS=2/UCX_MAX_RMA_RAILS=8/' /start_server.sh
# UCX 多端口
sed -i 's|UCX_NET_DEVICES=.*|UCX_NET_DEVICES=bnxt_re_bond0:1,bnxt_re_bond1:1,bnxt_re_bond2:1,bnxt_re_bond3:1,bnxt_re_bond4:1,bnxt_re_bond5:1,bnxt_re_bond6:1,bnxt_re_bond7:1|' /start_server.sh
sed -i '/UCX_IB_ROCE_REACHABILITY_MODE/a export UCX_IB_GID_INDEX=3' /start_server.sh
# fusion
sed -i 's|--compilation-config .*|--compilation-config '\''{"custom_ops": ["+rms_norm"], "pass_config": {"enable_sp": true, "fuse_gemm_comms": true}}'\''|' /start_server.sh
# P0 修复: --compilation-config 行末补反斜杠,让后续 --host/--port/--kv-transfer-config/$EXTRA_ARGS 真正传入 vllm
sed -i '/--compilation-config/ s/'\''$/'\'' \\/' /start_server.sh
exec /start_server.sh
